preconditions: identified target time-scale authority and version
requiredEvidence: mapping status distinguishing exact equivalence from conservative envelope
decisionLogic: apply a mapping only to an exact Japanese/English source-label pair
preserve target authority and version with every numerical interval
use a conservative envelope when source wording is not an exact formal-unit synonym
leave unmatched labels unresolved rather than guessing
outputs: closed Ma-before-present interval with mapping status and target units
uncertainty: a conservative envelope is an applicability bound, not a depositional-age probability distribution
exclusions: no precision beyond the source chart
no inference that a unit occupies the entire envelope
validationMethod: exact-label positive test, unmatched-label fail-closed test, tampering rejection and actual Aso catalog application
reopenCondition: GSJ publishes a more precise unit age or the controlling ICS chart changes
